spiritgiven.comments: Thank you for the enjoyable and intense game to start the tournament. We were especially impressed with your fair-mindedness in considering outcomes that were detrimental to your team, communication (introductions and high fives on the sideline) and positivity with congratulating all plays.

Loved playing a highly competitive game and rate the communication between leaders!!!
Body contact - in the first half, the level of physicality was acceptable. Second half, physicality increased and we felt there were multiple late bids which were potentially dangerous. Unfortunately there were only few points left so there was no opportunity to  discuss during the second half (opposite sidelines!).
We really loved all your team's positivity and smiles on the sideline and on field! There were some discussion with rules but all resolved and communicated effectively.

We really appreciate your receptiveness and responsiveness to feedback.
Body contact - there was an attempt to improve body contact after discussion between spirit captains during the first half. It did improve across some of your team but there were still individual players who maintained the same level of physicality, particularly on the catch.
It was an enjoyable and competitive game!

Thank you for the fantastic, tightly fought game.
We appreciate the spirit captains initiating communication and the excellent self-control. Congratulations!

Thank you for a well spirited game! Love the dancing ;)
We appreciate the communication, especially being forthcoming around the early pick calls.
Look forward to seeing you again!

Thank you for an incredibly enjoyable and spirited game.
We appreciate the love hearts and joining into our Aussie cheers!
You always maintained positivity, even if you were behind on the scoreboard.

Thank you for an tough and competitive battle. We commend your genuine positivity even with a scoreline disadvantage.
Contact improved from some athletes after discussion between SCs but there were still late bids where contact could have been avoided.
It is apparent that an individual athlete's spirit could improve and we feel that their/her teammates could step up to keep them/her accountable.
Thank you for the multiple authentic congratulations from a number of players.
Well done on adjusting your body contact compared to our pool game. Communication was also clear and calm. An enjoyable game, good luck for the final!
Thank you so much for such a great game and tournament!! Congratulations on bronze!!!!

spiritreceived.comments: What a bloody good game!!! We loved how positive and high-spirited the game was, despite how close the score was throughout the match. We thought calls were resolved in a really fair manner, but we did notice that in some instances the stall count was not dropped when infractions were called. The communication was top notch, and we really felt all the heart that you brought on the field. Ka pai and kia ora.
Great spirited game, all calls were resolved quickly and communication was clear. Fun game overall!
